How cool!|audio = FrostWave36-2.ogg|'''Professor V''' on Wave 30 ([[Frost Mode|Frost]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Deep Freeze''' is a [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It has a decent amount of health and average speed. As it is a [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy, only towers with lead detection can damage it. Additionally, it also has the [[Stun Immunity]], making it harder to stall. ==Logbook Description== "''The Deep Freeze is a formidable addition to the Frost Army. These slow but sturdy creatures clear paths for smaller units. Protected by reinforced armor as they travel the battlefield, Deep Freezes are natural frontline leaders in combat.''" ==Appearance== The '''Deep Freeze''' is a creature protected with pieces of reinforced armor, covering up its entire body. This armor is grey and dark grey with a few blue spikes coming out of it on its shoulders and the helmet. It also has visible fingers on its armor. Upon its death, it will fall to the ground and its helmet will fall of, revealing its black head and blue horns. ==Strategy== *As the '''Deep Freeze''' spawns with [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]], towers with lead detection like the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]], [[Turret]], [[Golden Demoman]] and [[Kingpin]] are required here. **Unit collisions has lead detection by default. This means towers which normally do not have lead detection, like the [[Necromancer]] or most [[Mercenary Base]] units, can damage it through collisions. *The [[Firework Technician]] can be used to give towers which cannot damage it lead detection. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} DeepFreezeWalk.gif|Walking animation (16 December 2024 – Present) DeepFreezeDeath.gif|Death animation (3 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDeepFreeze.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (3 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FrostModeReworkBanner.png|'''Deep Freeze''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Pulse Trooper Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Deep Freeze''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DeepFreezeIconIG.png|'''Deep Freeze''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Deep Freeze's''' death animation was originally made for the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]https://x.com/c4rpye/status/1868989206963667252, though it would not be seen used by it until the release of the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. *The '''Deep Freeze''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' -
